description: Use this when the user plans to ship the same vehicle on several legs of one trip, for example an overland or round-the-world trip (UK to South Africa, then South Africa to Australia). Ask for the vehicle details once and for each leg: from, to and when. Ask the user for THEIR OWN email address; never invent one. IVSS sends ONE email with a link per leg; each link opens the exact price for that leg, with sailings and how to book. Prices are never returned here. For one shipment use request_exact_quote. Use get_indicative_price first if the user only wants rough costs.

legs.description: The shipments in trip order, 2 to 6

reason.description: Only if this leg differs from the trip reason, e.g. "Returning to country of origin" for the last leg

ship_date.description: When this leg should ship, YYYY-MM-DD

personal_effects.description: True if belongings will be packed inside the vehicle

reason.description: Usually "Temporary Import" for an overland trip

user_agreed_privacy.description: True only if the user agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the prices

name: request_trip_quote
title: Get exact IVSS prices for a multi-leg trip by email (overlanders)
